Converting the mapped SMILES to standard SMILES gives the precursor pair: “CC(=O)c1c(O)cc(N(=O)=O)cc1” and “O=C1CCC1”. This is the only possible combination returned by the template.</thought>
<final_answer>[["CC(=O)c1c(O)cc(N(=O)=O)cc1", "O=C1CCC1"]]</final_answer>
